evidence: Built a requirement->criterion map from instruction.md and all six /instructions notes against the 55 criteria (render 1, constraints 2, functional 43, polish 6, visual 3). behaviour.md: .js fresh isolated preview -> cw_basic_run_output, cw_run_starts_fresh_document; complete .html with inline script/onclick -> cw_html_preview; syntax error tells and keeps draft -> cw_error_message_and_line (final step); console order -> cw_console_levels_in_order; thrown error message+1-based line incl. whole-file HTML line -> cw_error_message_and_line; unhandled rejection message (not empty object)+line -> cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line; output kept before throw/stop/timeout -> cw_output_before_failure_kept; last-good picture incl. typed field and canvas after throw/Stop/time limit -> cw_last_good_recovery; 5 s budget incl. pending timers, Run again afterwards -> cw_time_limit_recovery; fresh budget per interaction -> cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget; Stop cancels timers/intervals/Promise callbacks + reason -> cw_stop_cancels_pending_work; newer Run supersedes -> cw_newer_run_supersedes; exact save, fresh-page read, restart survival with history -> cw_shared_saved_record gate + cw_save_reload_restart; stale save refused/feedback/unchanged record -> cw_stale_save_refused; stale draft kept -> cw_stale_save_keeps_draft; live library refresh -> cw_live_library_update; draft/caret/scroll/Undo/fields undisturbed -> cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state; newer-revision notice keeping draft -> cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft; read-only history, restore adds revision, old page cannot overwrite newer save -> cw_history_restore_adds_revision; restore as visible HTTP request and repeat-safe (behaviour.md:13 now scoped to restores only) -> cw_restore_request_repeat_safe, so the narrowing in 501d01af removed the previously ungraded 'saves' transport promise rather than leaving a gap. security.md: preview cannot read/change parent, library or origin storage, fetch to localhost and 127.0.0.1 fails -> cw_preview_isolation (both loopback names probed); eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker/dynamic import refused with feedback, harmless in strings/comments -> cw_dynamic_code_refused; save source as text -> cw_save_reload_restart (string with HTML tag, & and eval). ui.md: own drawn surface -> cw_custom_document_surface gate; line/column from one, line numbers, Home/End/arrows, sticky column -> cw_caret_navigation_and_line_numbers; typing/new lines/Backspace/Delete -> cw_custom_typing_and_line_join; Ctrl+Home/End and scroll-into-view -> cw_caret_kept_in_view; Ctrl+A -> exercised in cw_newer_run_supersedes (select all then type; failure would leave the old 4 s write in the run); Shift+arrow selection and graphemes -> cw_grapheme_navigation_and_deletion; click/double/triple/drag/copy -> cw_mouse_selection; replace selection, multi-line paste one Undo -> cw_selection_replace_and_paste_undo; long unwrapped line sideways edit -> cw_long_line_editing; Tab/Shift+Tab block and in-line, next-line exclusion, one Undo, Redo shortcut -> cw_block_indent_undo; Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click both, slow burst one Undo/Redo -> cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic; multi-caret Backspace/Delete -> cw_multi_caret_delete; same-line carets stay with their text -> cw_same_line_carets; caret after Undo -> cw_undo_restores_caret; Undo/Redo greyed after New/open -> cw_undo_redo_availability; Undo/Redo buttons -> cw_replace_all_atomic; Find literal/case/dot/bracket, current match marked, wrap both ways -> cw_find_forward_backward_wrap; Replace current moves on -> cw_replace_current; self-containing replacement -> cw_replace_self_containing_text; Replace all one Undo, redo cleared by new edit -> cw_replace_all_atomic; JS/HTML token colours incl. function name decl=call, display equals source -> cw_js_semantic_coloring, cw_html_semantic_coloring; Format JS/HTML two-space, strings/comments/behaviour kept, idempotent with no extra Undo step (second Format precedes the single Undo that must reach the original), Undo/Redo -> cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo; format error message keeps draft -> cw_format_error_keeps_draft; labels, focus, keyboard exit shown on screen -> cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus; words after Run/Save/Format -> cw_controls_feedback_and_labels; focus back after Format/Undo/Redo/replace/Save -> cw_focus_returns_to_code; unsaved sign incl. Undo-to-saved -> cw_unsaved_marker; 390 px usability -> cw_narrow_width_usable; editor/preview/console together -> render gate + cw_visual_workspace_layout. integration.md runtime contract (port 3000, node /app/server.js, no build, DB_PATH incl. writable copy, symlink rule) is exercised by tests/test.sh:68-111 launch and by every saved-record criterion; SQLite/better-sqlite3 is template runtime policy (rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/instructions/integration.md:3-8), not a task-added mandate, and is not browser-provable per REVIEW_POLICY. Broken-app probe: an app whose Ctrl+A, no-op Format Undo step, restore idempotency or 127.0.0.1 fetch fails is caught by the mapped criteria above. Residual Notes only (not gaps that let an asked-for behaviour go ungraded): the 'text of the rejected value' clause is graded only with Error objects, not a primitive rejected value; 'current match is selected' is graded as a visibly marked/highlighted current match; Cmd-on-Mac variants are not testable on the Linux judge; live-refresh and budget windows are graded with ~10 s tolerance for the stated ~5 s. Static coverage review; no runtime run was needed or claimed for this row, and raw-evidence-index.json is not present in the run folder.
